prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 7 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, Night, warm interior downlights.
Image 1: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Lu Shaoze stands frozen at the elevator end of the autumn landscape painting, facing Ji Ran. Ji Ran stands at the front-door end of the painting, chin raised and eyes still red, the black handbag on her arm. The camera stays in front of the painting wall.
Panel 1: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze breaks into a scoffing laugh.
Panel 2: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran onto Lu Shaoze, eye-level. Lu Shaoze shakes his head and wags a finger at her.
Panel 3: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Ji Ran. Ji Ran presses her lips together and keeps her gaze on him.
Panel 4: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level, following Lu Shaoze as he leans closer. Lu Shaoze leans toward her and ticks the points off on his fingers.
Panel 5: Medium shot, low angle on Lu Shaoze with the painting behind him. Lu Shaoze spreads his hands wide in mock disbelief.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level on Ji Ran. Ji Ran turns her face slightly away, her jaw clenched.
Panel 7: Close-up, high angle, push in on Lu Shaoze as he looms over her. Lu Shaoze bends his face close to hers with a triumphant sneer.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
